test_case.test_name: Cable logical, assembly, continuity/insulation and signal validation — blocked pending stage matrix
test_case.purpose: Preserve this cable Source Identity and, once defined, independently verify every owner-required logical, physical-assembly, continuity/insulation and signal-integrity property for the exact harness and endpoints.
required_package: Exact cable/harness PN/revision, length/routing, source/destination boards, connectors, pinout and shielding
Approved stage matrix listing logical, visual/assembly, continuity/insulation and signal-integrity requirements separately
For logical stages: BMC/OOB controller/mux/bus/target/transaction and expected responses
For physical/electrical stages: safe power/isolation state, qualified operator, instrument/calibration, points and numeric limits
Endpoint/power/thermal monitoring, maintenance authorization, evidence plan and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED; perform no bus or physical cable action. After the exact cable and stage matrix receive fresh review, execute only approved stages: mapped BMC/OOB transactions for logical reachability; qualified-human visual/assembly work; pin-to-pin continuity/insulation measurements; and/or signal measurements in the specified load/power state. Capture each stage independently with endpoint/BMC/power/thermal health. Do not reuse row-1808 targets, infer endpoints, manipulate an energized unknown cable, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: No current executable PASS exists. Future PASS requires the correct harness/endpoints and every required stage independently meeting its approved logical response, assembly/retention, continuity/insulation and/or waveform/timing limits, with no endpoint, management, power or thermal health change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Current result is BLOCKED. MANUAL ONLY, a bus response or any single modality cannot PASS until the owner defines complete coverage. Missing cable/stage definition, wrong endpoint/pin, response mismatch, assembly defect, open/short/insulation or signal-limit failure, absent evidence or health anomaly is FAIL/BLOCKED for owner verdict.
safety_gate: Do not infer endpoints/pinout from Cable or scan buses to discover the harness.
Do not disconnect, reseat, back-probe or measure an energized unknown cable; use approved isolation and qualified humans.
Keep logical, visual, continuity/insulation and signal-integrity evidence and verdicts separate.
Stop on pinout mismatch, short, endpoint loss, bus, power or thermal anomaly; preserve evidence and do not retry/reset automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved cable definition and stage matrix with PN/revision/endpoints/connectors/pinout/routing
Logical BMC route/raw responses when required
Instrument/calibration and raw per-pin continuity/insulation or waveform/timing evidence when required
Pre/post endpoint, BMC, power and thermal health plus per-stage verdict and recovery audit
test_case.recovery: No action is authorized now. The approved contract must define an isolated safe state and recovery independent of the cable path. On anomaly stop and preserve evidence without retry; reseat, bus reset, reboot or power action is owner-controlled and separately authorized.
